comment: Loaded at boot via management.load_definitions (see rabbitmq.conf). Imports are additive — this declares only the dead-letter topology and policy; users/vhosts/permissions are managed elsewhere. Service consumers (dispatcher, downloader, notifier, ...) drop poison messages with a basic.nack(requeue=false); the 'dlx' policy routes those to the dead-letter exchange so they are retained in dead-letter-queue for inspection instead of being silently discarded.
